product_overview: GroupPad is a group trip planning platform centered on a public trip board where members discover, vote on, save, and compare homes. It supports organizer-led trip management, Scout AI recommendations, and a guided onboarding tour to help new users learn the workflow.
core_goals: Help groups collaboratively choose vacation homes through a shared board and voting process.
Provide organizer controls for trip creation, membership, submissions, and final decision locking.
Surface AI-powered ranking and insights based on approved group criteria.
Allow each member to privately save favorites while keeping the shared board public by link.
Support a smooth first-time experience through guided onboarding and board education.

features.name: Authentication & session
features.description: Users authenticate through passwordless magic links or Google OAuth, and the gp_session cookie identifies the current signed-in user for protected actions.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/request-link with a valid email -> Receive 200 with { ok: true } -> GET /api/auth/me with the session cookie -> Receive 200 with the current user object
POST /api/auth/request-link with missing or invalid email -> Receive 400 with an error response
PATCH /api/auth/me with valid name and avatar while authenticated -> Receive 200 with updated user data
PATCH /api/auth/me without a valid gp_session cookie -> Receive 401 Not authenticated
POST /api/auth/logout with or without a session cookie -> Receive 200 with { ok: true } -> GET /api/auth/me with the old cookie -> Receive null user

features.name: Trips
features.description: Signed-in users can create trips, view their own trip list, join trips, inspect public trip pages, and organizers can manage members or delete trips.
user_flows: POST /api/trips with name, destination, and budget while authenticated -> Receive 200 with a new Trip -> GET /api/me/trips with the same session -> Receive 200 with the trip included
GET /api/me/trips without authentication -> Receive 401 Not authenticated
GET /api/trips/:tripId for an existing trip such as la-birthday-2026 -> Receive 200 with the trip board data
GET /api/trips/:tripId for an unknown tripId -> Receive 404 Trip not found
POST /api/trips/:tripId/join with a valid session -> Receive 200 with { ok: true }
GET /api/trips/:tripId/members as a non-organizer authenticated user -> Receive 403 Not the trip organizer
DELETE /api/trips/:tripId as the organizer -> Receive 200 with { ok: true } -> GET /api/trips/:tripId -> Receive 404 Trip not found
DELETE /api/trips/:tripId as a non-organizer -> Receive 403 Not the trip organizer

features.name: Listings (board)
features.description: The trip board exposes the ranked homes and live pipeline listings publicly, while organizers can remove listings from the board.
user_flows: GET /api/trips/:tripId/listings for a populated trip such as la-birthday-2026 -> Receive 200 with Listing[]
GET /api/trips/:tripId/pipeline-listings for a trip that is still fetching inventory -> Receive 200 with Listing[] of in-pipeline homes
DELETE /api/trips/:tripId/listings/:id as the organizer -> Receive 200 with { ok: true }
DELETE /api/trips/:tripId/listings/:id as a non-organizer -> Receive 403 Not the trip organizer
GET /api/trips/:tripId/listings for a missing trip -> Receive 404 Trip not found

features.name: Voting
features.description: Members can cast or change votes on homes to influence which listings rise into the shortlist, and anyone can view current vote tallies.
user_flows: GET /api/trips/:tripId/votes for a trip -> Receive 200 with vote tallies keyed by listingId
POST /api/trips/:tripId/votes with listingId and value while authenticated -> Receive 200 with { ok: true } -> GET /api/trips/:tripId/votes -> Receive updated tallies
POST /api/trips/:tripId/votes without authentication -> Receive 401 Not authenticated

features.name: Community submissions
features.description: Trip members can submit homes they found, and organizers can remove submissions from the shared board.
user_flows: GET /api/trips/:tripId/submitted for a trip -> Receive 200 with Submission[]
POST /api/trips/:tripId/submit with a URL while authenticated -> Receive 200 with the created Submission
POST /api/trips/:tripId/submit without authentication -> Receive 401 Not authenticated
DELETE /api/trips/:tripId/submitted/:id as the organizer -> Receive 200 with { ok: true }
DELETE /api/trips/:tripId/submitted/:id as a non-organizer -> Receive 403 Not the trip organizer

features.name: Personal favorites
features.description: Each signed-in member can privately save and un-save homes to a personal Saved list for a trip.
user_flows: GET /api/trips/:tripId/favorites while authenticated -> Receive 200 with the member's saved listingId array
POST /api/trips/:tripId/favorites with a listingId while authenticated -> Receive 200 with updated favorites array
POST /api/trips/:tripId/favorites without authentication -> Receive 401 Not authenticated

features.name: Group criteria (caveats)
features.description: Members submit must-have criteria, organizers approve or remove them, and approved criteria are used by Scout AI ranking.
user_flows: GET /api/trips/:tripId/caveats for a trip -> Receive 200 with pending and approved caveats
POST /api/trips/:tripId/caveats with text while authenticated -> Receive 200 with a pending Caveat
POST /api/trips/:tripId/caveats without authentication -> Receive 401 Not authenticated
POST /api/trips/:tripId/caveats/:id/approve as the organizer -> Receive 200 with { ok: true }
POST /api/trips/:tripId/caveats/:id/approve as a non-organizer -> Receive 403 Not the trip organizer
DELETE /api/trips/:tripId/caveats/:id as the organizer -> Receive 200 with { ok: true }

features.name: Scout AI compare & insights
features.description: Scout AI compares homes and produces cached insights that reflect budget, distance, and approved group criteria.
user_flows: POST /api/trips/:tripId/compare-listings with an array of listingIds -> Receive 200 with { verdict, table }
GET /api/trips/:tripId/insights -> Receive 200 with cached insights, optionally marked stale
GET /api/trips/:tripId/insights after criteria changes -> Receive 200 with insights including stale: true

features.name: Decision lock
features.description: Members can cast final votes on the official pick, and the organizer can lock the trip decision.
user_flows: GET /api/trips/:tripId/final -> Receive 200 with { tallies, decision }
POST /api/trips/:tripId/final-vote while authenticated -> Receive 200 with { ok: true }
POST /api/trips/:tripId/final-vote without authentication -> Receive 401 Not authenticated
POST /api/trips/:tripId/decision as the organizer -> Receive 200 with { ok: true }
POST /api/trips/:tripId/decision as a non-organizer -> Receive 403 Not the trip organizer

features.name: Reviews & tours
features.description: The platform exposes public review data and AI-generated tour blurbs for listings on a trip.
user_flows: GET /api/trips/:tripId/reviews for a populated trip -> Receive 200 with review data grouped by listingId
GET /api/trips/:tripId/tours for a populated trip -> Receive 200 with generated tour blurbs
GET /api/trips/:tripId/reviews for an unknown trip -> Receive the trip-specific error response if no data exists

features.name: Listing search
features.description: Organizers can trigger a fresh listing search, while everyone can poll status and activity pulses.
user_flows: POST /api/trips/:tripId/refresh as the organizer -> Receive 200 with { ok: true } -> GET /api/trips/:tripId/search-status -> Receive 200 with current status
POST /api/trips/:tripId/refresh as a non-organizer -> Receive 403 Not the trip organizer
POST /api/trips/:tripId/refresh repeatedly within the rate limit window -> Receive 429 Rate limited
GET /api/trips/:tripId/search-status -> Receive 200 with { status }
GET /api/trips/:tripId/pulse -> Receive 200 with { pulse }

features.name: Admin
features.description: Super-admin users can verify admin access and inspect platform usage metrics.
user_flows: GET /api/admin/verify with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with { ok: true }
GET /api/admin/usage with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with { usage }
GET /api/admin/verify without admin privileges -> Receive 403 Not admin
GET /api/admin/usage without admin privileges -> Receive 403 Not admin

known_limitations.issue: Authentication is passwordless (magic-link / Google OAuth) — there is no username+password endpoint, so a test client must present a valid gp_session cookie to exercise auth-gated routes.
known_limitations.impact: Without a session cookie only public GET endpoints and public reads are reachable; auth/organizer routes return 401/403.

known_limitations.issue: Persistence is per-trip JSON files rather than a database; there is no transactional isolation.
known_limitations.impact: Heavy concurrent writes to the same trip rely on atomic file writes; no row-level locking.

known_limitations.issue: Many handlers are data-dependent on a seeded trip (la-birthday-2026).
known_limitations.impact: Endpoints should be exercised against tripId=la-birthday-2026 for populated, realistic data.
